messages.author: b92b0e53baf64e49
messages.subject: Re: biocLite.R fails (a bug?)
parts:
Hello Pawel,

We were able to replicate your issue using RRO 8.0.2. There was a default repository settings issue in RRO 8.0.2 that has since been fixed in RRO 8.0.3. 

We recommend that you install RRO 8.0.3 from http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/download/#download

Also, please note that the 'official' way to install the biocLite set of packages is to run the following from a R console prompt:

source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")

biocLite()

As always, please let us know how it goes.

Thank you!
